components.description: Outlined secondary action that inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.6rem 1.1rem; border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #262626); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #262626); font-family: "SpaceGrotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--ink, #262626); color: var(--paper, #ededed); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #262626); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.15rem; padding: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #7f7f7f); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); background: var(--card, #f5f5f5); } .ds-dock-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); font-family: "SpaceGrotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; color: var(--muted, #5f5f5f); white-space: nowrap; transition: color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s; } .ds-dock-link.is-active { color: var(--ink, #262626); font-weight: 600; } .ds-dock-link.is-active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0.85rem; right: 0.85rem; bottom: 0.4rem; height: 1px; background: currentColor; } .ds-dock-link:hover, .ds-dock-link:focus-visible { color: var(--paper, #ededed); background: var(--ink, #262626); } .ds-dock-link.is-active:hover::after, .ds-dock-link.is-active:focus-visible::after { background: var(--paper, #ededed); } .ds-dock-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #262626); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Soft paper card with an image plate, index, status, title, tags, and arrow.

narrative.overview:
The portfolio behaves like a printed portfolio sheet: one gray paper field, graphite ink, hairline rules, and work framed and hung with generous air. Nothing is tinted and nothing floats on a shadow. Separation comes from hairlines, a single tonal step, inversion, and scale. The giant Syne wordmark supplies the poster voice, Neuton supplies the book voice, and Space Grotesk handles the small printed labels. The interface stays achromatic so project screenshots and technology logos carry all of the color.

Motion is the tactility of the paper. A pixel-grid wipe turns pages, a project card physically becomes its detail view, and the tech stack can be flicked like loose tiles. The grammar is mechanical and controlled: power2/power3 easing, no bounce, no decorative loop. The shell itself never scrolls as a page; each view is a plate in a fixed frame with its own inner scroll, so the identity header, dock, and site mark stay put.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic chrome: newsprint gray, graphite ink, pencil hairlines. No accent hue.
Poster-scale display type against book-scale reading type, with no mid-size hero in between.
Flat surfaces at rest and on hover; depth is tonal and linear, never shadowed.
A single 4px corner radius on every rectangle; circles only for the tech bubbles.
Fixed app shell with per-view scrolling and safe-area-aware edges.
Signature motion: pixel wipe, FLIP modal, proximity-scaled gallery, inertia drag.
Reduced-motion support is part of the product, not an enhancement.

rules.name: The No Chroma Rule
rules.body: The interface holds zero hue. Color enters only through project screenshots and technology logos, never through chrome, states, or focus rings.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Interactive emphasis inverts ink and paper, or shifts exactly one tonal step. It never tints, glows, or adds a colored accent.

rules.name: The Scale Contrast Rule
rules.body: Type is either poster (8–11vw) or print (0.65–1.35rem). A mid-size hero between roughly 2.5rem and 8vw is out of system and competes with the wordmark.

rules.name: The Tracking Rule
rules.body: Display tightens (-0.03 to -0.06em); labels open up (0.04–0.12em). Never reverse the two.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears only in the loading screen's outline wordmark. It is not promoted into page typography.

rules.name: The One Screen Rule
rules.body: The page itself never scrolls. The shell stays fixed and only the view's body scrolls; chrome never scrolls away.

rules.name: The Safe-Area Rule
rules.body: Every fixed or full-bleed edge accounts for env(safe-area-inset-*). Full-bleed is never edge-to-edge on a notched device.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, or blur. If two things need separation, use a hairline or one tonal step; if one needs emphasis, invert it or scale it.

rules.name: The Motion-Is-Depth Rule
rules.body: Tactility comes from movement (wipe, FLIP, proximity scale, inertia), never from lighting effects.

rules.name: The One Radius Rule
rules.body: Rectangles get 4px. Circles get 50%. No other corner value is introduced.

dos: Do keep the interface achromatic; let screenshots and logos be the only color.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines or the Newsprint Gray → Soft Paper step.
Do use the 4px radius on every rectangle and reserve 50% for circles.
Do set display type at poster scale (8–11vw) and reading type at 0.95–1.3rem.
Do use Syne for names and titles, Neuton for sentences, Space Grotesk for labels and UI.
Do invert ink and paper for hover emphasis.
Do keep the shell fixed and scroll inside the view.
Do keep interactive targets at least 44px tall and focus outlines visible.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion by removing wipes, gallery scaling, FLIP, and inertia while keeping all content reachable.
Do pad fixed edges with env(safe-area-inset-*).
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, gradients, or glass. The only gradient is the 22% black photo scrim.
Don't add an accent color, tinted state, or colored focus ring.
Don't use pill or large soft radii, or rounded SaaS-style cards.
Don't introduce a mid-size display headline between roughly 2.5rem and 8vw.
Don't promote Fraunces beyond the loading outline wordmark.
Don't animate filter, blur, or drop-shadow per frame; animate transform and opacity only.
Don't make the document body scroll or let the chrome scroll away.
Don't use decorative iconography; the vocabulary is line arrows, check, copy, and close.
Don't drop body text below 0.95rem or labels below 0.65rem.
